newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco unleaded surges on NYMEX rally, APIs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco unleaded surges on NYMEX rally, APIs.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel prices surged higher late Tuesday on a rally in the NYMEX front-month complex and bullish stocks estimates, traders said.

Midwest gasoline inventories were drawn down 1.2 million barrels last week and distillate stocks were down 948,000 barrels, the American Petroleum Institute said in its weekly petroleum products survey.
Trade remained thin late in the day as players began drifting back into the spot markets from this week's National Petroleum Refiners Association annual conference in San Antonio, Texas.

At the conference, the big topic of discussion in the hospitality suites had less to do with prices and more to do with survival as a looming consolidation in the downstream industry threatens to slash employment among refiners.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 4.0 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Group Three and remained 3.75 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago for prompt deliveries, traders said.
High sulphur diesel was talked 2.0 cents a gallon over the print in Group Three and 1.75 cents over in Chicago for all March timings, traders said.
Unleaded gasoline was bid 2.75 cents a gallon under NYMEX April unleaded in Group Three and 9.25 cents a gallon under the print for winter-grade unleaded in Chicago.
